Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

MANEUVERING JETS EMPLACEMENT POINTS AVAILABILITY SIZE RESTRICTION COST
+2 2 Common - 2000 (Base)
+4 3 Common Colossal or Smaller 5000 (Base)
+6 4 Licensed Gargantuan or Smaller 10000 (Base)

It is possible to increase a Starship's ability to pitch, jink, and roll by adding additional small ion jets that automatically fire during extreme maneuvers. Although all Starships include some maneuvering thrusters, special Maneuvering Jets give more power to perform maneuvers beyond a Starship's normal capacity.

Maneuvering Jets give a Starship a +2, +4, or +6 Equipment bonus to its Dexterity score.
